FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something strange. The king, a stout and jovial man with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his advisors, a group of stern-looking men in suits.

KING (he) "I have had enough of this drab, medieval aesthetic. It's time for a change. I want our kingdom to be the most...futuristic...of all time."

ADVISOR 1 (he) "But, your majesty, we are in the 14th century. We can't just...vaporwave...our entire empire."

KING (he) "Nonsense. I have a vision. I want our kingdom to be a utopia of...synthwave...and...retro-futurism."

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his advisors, who are all looking on in confusion.

KING (he) "I want our flags to be replaced with...neon-lit...slogans. Our coats of arms to be adorned with...glitchy... graphics. And our architecture to be designed with...curved...lines and...futuristic... materials."

ADVISOR 2 (he) "But, your majesty, this is madness. We can't just...disrupt...the entire aesthetic of our kingdom."

KING (he) "I don't care. I want our kingdom to be the most...avant-garde...of all time. I want our people to be...fashionable...and...forward-thinking."

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The king's advisors are seen implementing the king's vision. They are painting the walls with...neon-lit...colors, and installing...futuristic...lighting fixtures. They are also replacing the traditional coats of arms with...glitchy... graphics.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is seen admiring his new aesthetic. He is surrounded by...neon-lit...slogans, and...glitchy... graphics adorn the walls.

KING (he) "Ah, yes. This is more like it. I am the...most stylish...king in all the land."

ADVISOR 3 (he) "But, your majesty, this is...confusing. Our people are...lost...in the...futuristic... landscape."

KING (he) "Nonsense. I want our people to be...adventurous...and...open-minded. I want our kingdom to be a...utopia...of...synthwave...and...retro-futurism."

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a bustling hub of...futuristic... activity. People are walking around with...neon-lit...slogans on their clothes, and...glitchy... graphics adorn the walls.

KING (he) "Ah, yes. This is the...future...of our kingdom. And I am the...most stylish...king in all the land."

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
